text_block_list.text:
Phew... I've completed the workout sets.
Doing high knees on the
sand is quite
exhausting.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: All right. Let's take a ten-minute breather.

text_block_list.text: Understood.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ needs to work on the
basics, so we're at summer camp
doing
core training on the beach.

We use our perfectly designed training
plan to get consistent results.
Everything
goes smoothly—that is, until near the end
of the day...
Pant... Pant... How did I do?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Your time's really improved! And you've
steadily been getting faster
since camp
started. Let's keep up this pace!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А's Trainer

text_block_list.text: Oh! Got it! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
A bright-eyed Umamusume is producing
good results nearby.
Hayahide probably
can't help but notice her.

While we're doing basic drills, she might
get impatient seeing others
making
dramatic gains. That's not unusual when
first starting to run
races.

Hm? Why wouldn't I be? Of course I'm
fine. All right, ten minutes are
up—let's
get back to training.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
With nothing else to say about it, we stick
to the plan and continue
her training.

There, we're done for today. All finished
and according to schedule.
Perfect.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Let's go back to the camp
dorms.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Just as I feel like my worries are
unfounded when I see her so calm,
she
looks over at me.

Oh yes, I was wondering... What are your
plans for the evening?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Gulp. Don't tell me you want to add even more
training to the schedule...

text_block_list.text:
Hah... You must think I'm a glutton for
punishment. You wouldn't be
wrong
though.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I'm simply asking what your plans
tonight are. If you're free,
there's
somewhere I'd like to take you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I feel like we haven't had a single
conversation since camp
started, other
than to talk about training.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's a little soon, but I want to reflect on
our progress. No... That's not
right. I
should state my intentions clearly.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What I mean to say is... I want to go to the
festival with you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Tap, tap, tap... Crack!
Ah!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Oh, almost had it! But you split the fish tail
into pieces. Too bad!
Better luck next
time!
text_block_list.name: Game Operator

text_block_list.text:
Rats... Another failure. Theoretically, I
should be able to cut an
impeccable shape
if I take the weakness of the grooves into

account...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide has brought me to a summer
festival near camp.

Having enjoyed a stroll around the
attractions, we're now trying our
hand at
the candy-cutting game.

I sharpened the toothpick. I've also made
preparations to counter
particulate
accumulation. Everything was perfect... But
why? Did I
miscalculate the applied force?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: I think you're leaning your shoulder in too hard.

text_block_list.text:
Yes... It appears so. My calculations were
accurate, but putting them
into effect
made me flustered, thus leading to a bad
outcome.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So, however flawless the formula, if I can't
match it with my abilities,
it's no more than
a useless string of random numbers.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If an individual has innate talent and
dedication... My sister, for
example—she'd
be able to prove the formula without
difficulty.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Saying this, her eyes wander upwards to
the sea of stars shimmering in
the night
sky.

I'm sure Brian won't choose another path.
However hard it is, she'll
train those
amazing legs she was born with... and go
to the top.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But it's different for me. I have to calculate
the shortest route, remove
obstacles, and
adjust my running just to make it to the
starting line.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And yet... it's fine that way. That's simply
who I am.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I see no resignation in her smile—only the
radiance of someone who
confronted and
accepted herself.

I was nothing special before—always
scrambling to gain a footing. But
I found
my talent, developed it, and became the
person I am now.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And you accepted me for exactly who I
am.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's why it's fine. Even if I don't get
there as fast as I'd like, I'll
move boldly
forward and trust in my ability. That's my
path.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
In other words, I wanted to say there's no
need to worry. Every day I'm
growing in
both mind and body.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's all. And now, to use a strategy
certain to obliterate this
candy-cutting
game. I can already see victory!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'll get it this time!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: After a few more attempts...
Tap, tap, tap... Snap!
Ah! I did it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I did it! Look, I cut it out beautifully!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's mighty impressive! This is the best
cut I've ever seen! You
showed real
tenacity! What a win!
text_block_list.name: Game Operator

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed. I make an art out of
persevering until I've reached the
perfect
solution.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Right, Тренер? Heheh.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The festive night becomes a wonderful
memory. And with our minds
and bodies
refreshed, the final day of summer camp
arrives.
Hup... Haaah!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
As I check Бива Хаяхидэ's time to see
how she's improved, I can
barely recognize
her running...

How was it? That should be my maximum
output. Did we reach our
goal?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Good!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Going through the fundamentals led to
success. This method really
does suit me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
An equation for growth that leads to
victory... And I discovered it
with you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
She looks out over the expansive horizon.
But no matter how far she
sets her aim, I
know she'll reach it.

And together—we will complete the
winning equation!
